title: register_map
description: INPUT CONTRACT for env.manifest.json's dut_facts.registers layer -- this file is never generated by this harness, and env_manifest.py only reads/validates it, never invents register content for a specific project. It is modeled on the fields a real RAL model or IP-XACT register description would export (name/address/width/fields/access), so a real project provides this file by exporting its own RAL model to this shape, converting a real IP-XACT XML to this shape, or hand-authoring it FROM a real register spec/programming guide -- never by an agent guessing plausible-looking register content. No live RAL model exists in dv_harness itself (dv_harness is the meta-harness, not a generated project environment), which is exactly why this is a documented input contract rather than a live extractor.

kind.description: Where this file's content actually came from, e.g. 'ral_model_export', 'ip_xact_conversion', 'programming_guide_transcription'.

blocks.description: One entry per register block/address map region. Order carries no meaning.

address_offset.description: Hex string, relative to the enclosing block's base_address.

access.description: Register-level default access; individual fields may override it.

reset_value.description: Hex string, or null when genuinely unknown/not-yet-documented -- never a guessed placeholder.

access_kind.description: RAL/IP-XACT-style access encoding: RW read-write, RO read-only, WO write-only, W1C write-1-to-clear, RW1C read-write with write-1-to-clear, RC read-clears, WC write-clears, W1S write-1-to-set.
